name: tooltip
title: Tooltip 提示
description: 悬停或聚焦时显示的简短文字说明。

whenToUse: 解释图标按钮或缩写的含义

whenNotToUse.case: 关键信息（触屏无法悬停）

accessibility: 不能替代图标按钮的 aria-label
responsive: 触屏设备无悬停，重要信息不要只放在提示里

files.content:
# Tooltip 设计规范

- 根布局放一次 `Tooltip.Provider`，包住所有会出现提示的内容；没有 Provider 时 `Tooltip.Root` 会报错。Sidebar 的 `Sidebar.Provider` 已自带一个。
- 显示延迟由 `Tooltip.Provider` 的 `delayDuration` 统一决定，默认 500 ms。键盘聚焦后可立即显示提示，按 Escape 关闭。默认无进入与退出动效。
- 提示只放简短的纯文字说明；不要放按钮、链接、输入框等可操作内容，它们无法聚焦和点击，改用 Popover（检查规则 `valar/tooltip-no-interactive`）。
- 提示不能代替名称：只有图标的按钮仍然要写 `aria-label`（见 Button 规范），Tooltip 只是给鼠标用户的补充。
- 触屏设备没有悬停，关键信息不要只放在提示里。
- 触发元素必须可聚焦：给 `Tooltip.Trigger` 设 `class={buttonVariants({ ... })}`，或用 `child` snippet 渲染 Button（检查规则 `valar/trigger-child-snippet`）；不要给纯文字或禁用的按钮加提示，禁用按钮收不到悬停和焦点。
- 方向用 `side` 属性（默认 `top`），碰撞时会自动翻转。内容在视口内换行。重要的禁用原因应同时放在控件附近的可见文字中。

- 工作区图标按钮可用 `Tooltip.Hint`。在 `trigger` snippet 里把 `props` 展开到原按钮或菜单触发器，沿用它的 `aria-label`。快捷键已实现时，用 `keys` 显示键帽，并给控件设 `aria-keyshortcuts`。
- 默认使用 8 px 圆角（默认主题）、8 × 5 px 内边距的无箭头实色提示。已有图表可显式传入 `arrowClasses` 保留箭头。工作区提示使用 `Tooltip.Provider delayDuration={500}`；工具栏提示放下方，底部输入栏用 `side="top"`。由浮层管理碰撞和边缘间距。

<script lang="ts">
	import type { Snippet } from "svelte";

	let {
		to: _to,
		disabled: _disabled,
		children,
	}: {
		to?: string | Element | DocumentFragment | null;
		disabled?: boolean;
		children?: Snippet;
	} = $props();
</script>

{@render children?.()}

<script lang="ts">
	import { setContext, type Snippet } from "svelte";
	import { TOOLTIP_PROVIDER_KEY } from "./context.js";

	let {
		delayDuration = 500,
		skipDelayDuration = 300,
		disableHoverableContent: _disableHoverableContent,
		disabled = false,
		children,
	}: {
		delayDuration?: number;
		skipDelayDuration?: number;
		disableHoverableContent?: boolean;
		disabled?: boolean;
		children?: Snippet;
	} = $props();

	let openCount = 0;
	let lastClosedAt = -Infinity;

	setContext(TOOLTIP_PROVIDER_KEY, {
		get delayDuration() {
			return delayDuration;
		},
		get skipDelayDuration() {
			return skipDelayDuration;
		},
		get disabled() {
			return disabled;
		},
		isWarm() {
			return openCount > 0 || performance.now() - lastClosedAt < skipDelayDuration;
		},
		notifyOpen(isOpen: boolean) {
			if (isOpen) {
				openCount += 1;
			} else {
				openCount = Math.max(0, openCount - 1);
				lastClosedAt = performance.now();
			}
		},
	});
</script>

{@render children?.()}

<script lang="ts">
	import type { ComponentProps } from "svelte";
	import TooltipProviderScope from "./tooltip-provider-scope.svelte";

	// Installed presets can override the default delay through this style class.
	const styleDelay = Number(/\bdelay-(\d+)\b/.exec("")?.[1] ?? 500);

	let {
		delayDuration = styleDelay,
		...restProps
	}: ComponentProps<typeof TooltipProviderScope> = $props();
</script>

<TooltipProviderScope {delayDuration} {...restProps} />

<script lang="ts" generics="T = never">
	import { TooltipTrigger as SdkTrigger, type TooltipController } from "@ui-sdk/svelte/tooltip";
	import { getContext, type Snippet } from "svelte";
	import type { HTMLButtonAttributes } from "svelte/elements";
	import { TOOLTIP_FOCUS_KEY, bindElementRef, type TooltipFocusContext } from "./context.js";

	let {
		ref = $bindable(null),
		payload,
		controller,
		disabled,
		type = "button",
		onpointerenter,
		onpointerleave,
		onpointerdown,
		onclick,
		onfocus,
		child,
		children,
		...restProps
	}: Omit<HTMLButtonAttributes, "children" | "disabled"> & {
		ref?: HTMLElement | null;
		payload?: T;
		controller?: TooltipController<T>;
		disabled?: boolean | null;
		child?: Snippet<[{ props: Record<string, unknown> }]>;
		children?: Snippet;
	} = $props();

	const focusCtx = getContext<TooltipFocusContext | undefined>(TOOLTIP_FOCUS_KEY);
	const refAttachment = bindElementRef<HTMLElement>((el) => {
		ref = el;
	});
	let pointerInside = false;
	let clickedOutside = false;

	function handlePointerEnter(event: PointerEvent & { currentTarget: EventTarget & HTMLButtonElement }) {
		pointerInside = true;
		if (focusCtx) {
			focusCtx.pointerEnteredAt = performance.now();
			if (clickedOutside && event.pointerType !== "touch" && !focusCtx.disabled && !disabled) {
				clickedOutside = false;
				focusCtx.scheduleHoverOpen();
			}
		}
		onpointerenter?.(event);
	}

	function handlePointerLeave(event: PointerEvent & { currentTarget: EventTarget & HTMLButtonElement }) {
		pointerInside = false;
		clickedOutside = false;
		focusCtx?.cancelPendingHoverOpen();
		if (focusCtx?.openedByHoverTimer) {
			focusCtx.openedByHoverTimer = false;
			void focusCtx.controller.close();
		}
		onpointerleave?.(event);
	}

	function handlePointerDown(event: PointerEvent & { currentTarget: EventTarget & HTMLButtonElement }) {
		if (focusCtx) {
			focusCtx.pointerDown = true;
			queueMicrotask(() => {
				focusCtx.pointerDown = false;
			});
		}
		onpointerdown?.(event);
	}

	function handleClick(event: MouseEvent & { currentTarget: EventTarget & HTMLButtonElement }) {
		if (!pointerInside) {
			clickedOutside = true;
		}
		onclick?.(event);
	}

	function handleFocus(event: FocusEvent & { currentTarget: EventTarget & HTMLButtonElement }) {
		onfocus?.(event);
		if (
			!focusCtx ||
			focusCtx.disabled ||
			focusCtx.pointerDown ||
			disabled ||
			performance.now() - focusCtx.lastDismissedAt < 200
		)
			return;
		const target = event.currentTarget;
		if (target.matches(":disabled")) return;
		queueMicrotask(() => {
			if (
				document.activeElement === target &&
				!focusCtx.controller.isOpen() &&
				performance.now() - focusCtx.lastDismissedAt >= 200
			) {
				void focusCtx.controller.open();
			}
		});
	}
</script>

<SdkTrigger
	{payload}
	{controller}
	onpointerenter={handlePointerEnter}
	onpointerleave={handlePointerLeave}
	onpointerdown={handlePointerDown}
	onclick={handleClick}
	onfocus={handleFocus}
	{...restProps}
>
	{#snippet render({ props, state })}
		{@const attributes = {
			...props,
			...(disabled != null ? { disabled } : {}),
			"data-slot": "tooltip-trigger",
			"data-state": state.open ? "open" : "closed",
			"data-delay-duration": focusCtx ? String(focusCtx.delayDuration) : undefined,
			...refAttachment,
		}}
		{#if child}
			{@render child({ props: attributes })}
		{:else}
			<button {type} {...attributes}>{@render children?.()}</button>
		{/if}
	{/snippet}
</SdkTrigger>

<script lang="ts" generics="T = never">
	import {
		Tooltip as SdkTooltip,
		createTooltipController,
		type TooltipController,
		type TooltipOpenChangeReason,
		type TooltipPayloadChangeReason,
	} from "@ui-sdk/svelte/tooltip";
	import type { ChangeDetails } from "@ui-sdk/core";
	import { getContext, onDestroy, setContext, type Snippet } from "svelte";
	import {
		TOOLTIP_FOCUS_KEY,
		TOOLTIP_POLICY_KEY,
		TOOLTIP_PROVIDER_KEY,
		type TooltipDismissPolicy,
		type TooltipProviderContext,
	} from "./context.js";

	const PARENT_ESCAPE_KEY = Symbol.for("valar-dialog-parent-escape");

	let {
		open = $bindable(),
		defaultOpen,
		delayDuration,
		delay,
		closeDelay,
		disabled: disabledProp,
		disableHoverableContent: _disableHoverableContent,
		disableCloseOnTriggerClick,
		toggleable,
		closeOnPress,
		type,
		shortcut,
		controller,
		container,
		onOpenChange,
		onOpenChangeComplete,
		onPayloadChange,
		children,
	}: {
		open?: boolean;
		defaultOpen?: boolean;
		delayDuration?: number;
		delay?: number;
		closeDelay?: number;
		disabled?: boolean;
		disableHoverableContent?: boolean;
		disableCloseOnTriggerClick?: boolean;
		toggleable?: boolean;
		closeOnPress?: boolean;
		type?: "label" | "description";
		shortcut?: string;
		controller?: TooltipController<T>;
		container?: Element | DocumentFragment | null;
		onOpenChange?: (open: boolean, details?: ChangeDetails<TooltipOpenChangeReason>) => void;
		onOpenChangeComplete?: (open: boolean) => void;
		onPayloadChange?: (
			payload: unknown,
			details: ChangeDetails<TooltipPayloadChangeReason>
		) => void;
		children?: Snippet;
	} = $props();

	const provider = getContext<TooltipProviderContext | undefined>(TOOLTIP_PROVIDER_KEY);
	const parentEscape = getContext<(() => void) | undefined>(PARENT_ESCAPE_KEY);
	const resolvedDisabled = $derived(disabledProp ?? provider?.disabled ?? false);
	const resolvedDelay = $derived(delay ?? delayDuration ?? provider?.delayDuration ?? 500);
	const internalController = createTooltipController<T>();
	const resolvedController = $derived(controller ?? internalController);

	let hoverTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;
	let wasOpen = false;

	function cancelPendingHoverOpen() {
		if (hoverTimer !== null) {
			clearTimeout(hoverTimer);
			hoverTimer = null;
		}
	}

	function scheduleHoverOpen() {
		if (resolvedDisabled) return;
		cancelPendingHoverOpen();
		const wait = provider?.isWarm() ? 0 : resolvedDelay;
		if (wait <= 0) {
			focusContext.openedByHoverTimer = true;
			void resolvedController.open();
			return;
		}
		hoverTimer = setTimeout(() => {
			hoverTimer = null;
			focusContext.openedByHoverTimer = true;
			void resolvedController.open();
		}, wait);
	}

	onDestroy(() => {
		cancelPendingHoverOpen();
		if (wasOpen) {
			provider?.notifyOpen(false);
			wasOpen = false;
		}
	});

	const focusContext = {
		get controller() {
			return resolvedController as TooltipController<unknown>;
		},
		get disabled() {
			return resolvedDisabled;
		},
		get delayDuration() {
			return resolvedDelay;
		},
		pointerDown: false,
		pointerEnteredAt: 0,
		openedByHoverTimer: false,
		lastDismissedAt: -Infinity,
		cancelPendingHoverOpen,
		scheduleHoverOpen,
	};
	setContext(TOOLTIP_FOCUS_KEY, focusContext);

	let policy: TooltipDismissPolicy = {};
	setContext(TOOLTIP_POLICY_KEY, {
		set(next: TooltipDismissPolicy) {
			policy = next;
		},
		get disabled() {
			return resolvedDisabled;
		},
	});

	function handleOpenChange(next: boolean, details: ChangeDetails<TooltipOpenChangeReason>) {
		if (resolvedDisabled && next) {
			details.cancel();
			return;
		}
		if (next) {
			// Enforce per-Provider warm group isolation so a tooltip open in another Provider
			// does not collapse this Provider's configured hover delay to 0ms.
			if (
				details.reason === "trigger-hover" &&
				resolvedDelay > 0 &&
				provider &&
				!provider.isWarm()
			) {
				const elapsed =
					focusContext.pointerEnteredAt > 0
						? performance.now() - focusContext.pointerEnteredAt
						: 0;
				if (elapsed < resolvedDelay - 30) {
					details.cancel();
					cancelPendingHoverOpen();
					const remaining = Math.max(0, Math.round(resolvedDelay - elapsed));
					hoverTimer = setTimeout(() => {
						hoverTimer = null;
						focusContext.openedByHoverTimer = true;
						void resolvedController.open();
					}, remaining);
					return;
				}
			}
		} else {
			cancelPendingHoverOpen();
			focusContext.openedByHoverTimer = false;
		}
		if (!next) {
			if (
				(details.reason === "outside-press" ||
					details.reason === "focus-out" ||
					details.reason === "window-blur") &&
				(policy.interactOutsideBehavior === "ignore" ||
					policy.interactOutsideBehavior === "defer-otherwise-ignore")
			) {
				details.cancel();
				return;
			}
			if (
				details.reason === "escape-key" &&
				(policy.escapeKeydownBehavior === "ignore" ||
					policy.escapeKeydownBehavior === "defer-otherwise-ignore")
			) {
				details.cancel();
				if (policy.escapeKeydownBehavior === "defer-otherwise-ignore") {
					parentEscape?.();
				}
				return;
			}
			if (details.reason === "outside-press" && policy.onInteractOutside) {
				const event = new CustomEvent("interactOutside", {
					cancelable: true,
					detail: { originalEvent: details.event },
				});
				policy.onInteractOutside(event);
				if (event.defaultPrevented) {
					details.cancel();
					return;
				}
			}
			if (details.reason === "escape-key" && policy.onEscapeKeydown) {
				const event = new KeyboardEvent("keydown", { key: "Escape", cancelable: true });
				policy.onEscapeKeydown(event);
				if (event.defaultPrevented) {
					details.cancel();
					return;
				}
			}
		}
		onOpenChange?.(next, details);
		if (!details.canceled && next !== wasOpen) {
			wasOpen = next;
			provider?.notifyOpen(next);
		}
		if (!next && !details.canceled && details.reason === "escape-key") {
			focusContext.lastDismissedAt = performance.now();
			details.event?.stopPropagation();
		}
	}
</script>

<SdkTooltip
	bind:open
	{defaultOpen}
	delay={resolvedDelay}
	{closeDelay}
	disabled={resolvedDisabled}
	{toggleable}
	closeOnPress={disableCloseOnTriggerClick ? false : closeOnPress}
	{type}
	{shortcut}
	controller={resolvedController}
	{container}
	onOpenChange={handleOpenChange}
	{onOpenChangeComplete}
	{onPayloadChange}
>
	{@render children?.()}
</SdkTooltip>
